title: Gherkin: claim/lease primitives (resource, owner, claim_id, contention, TTL, renew, expire, release, collision, failure)
description:
## Behavior to specify

One protocol, independent of Git / MQTT / DynamoDB:

- resource identity, owner identity, claim IDs
- contention window (discover simultaneous claims) separate from lease TTL (winner ownership)
- heartbeat/renewal during long work
- expiration returns abandoned work to eligibility
- release/completion
- deterministic tie-break when competing claims appear in the contention window
- failure modes (timeout, lost renewal, split brain at each provider strength)

## Notes

Do not reuse `kbs update --claim` for this. That command sets assignee and `in_progress`; it is not a lease.

## Acceptance

Gherkin scenarios are the contract. Dual-runtime implementation is a later story.
